name: ILLUSTRATIVE: Medicare enrollment document check
summary: Illustrative rules: people 65 or older, or younger people with a qualifying disability, who are US citizens or long-term lawful residents.

eligibility.nationality_note: Non-citizens may qualify with 5+ years of lawful permanent residence (needs a green card).
eligibility.age_exception_note: Under 65 can qualify after receiving disability benefits, or with ESRD or ALS.
eligibility.timeline_note: Initial enrollment runs from 3 months before to 3 months after the 65th-birthday month.

required_documents.label: Proof of age (birth certificate or passport)
required_documents.why: Age 65 is the main way to qualify.
required_documents.fix: Upload a birth certificate or passport showing the date of birth.

required_documents.label: Proof of citizenship or lawful permanent residence
required_documents.why: Medicare requires citizenship or long-term lawful residence.
required_documents.fix: Upload a US passport, naturalization certificate, or green card.
